Evidence/VIS-OECD-FCP-TIMELINE
Evidence record

Consumer protection and financial capability: from framework to implementation

What does this evidence establish?

The Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) announced Financial Consumer Protection Regulatory Instructions on 28 August 2023 and issued a consumer-protection awareness brochure on 23 March 2024, which describes a complaint and escalation path. The OECD's 2026 review of Yemen's financial sector provides context and recommendations. Apart from the brochure's own account of a dedicated consumer-protection department, no evidence on implementation, complaint handling, enforcement or consumer outcomes is held; a framework or guidance document is not evidence that protection works in practice.

What does it measure?

The stages of financial consumer protection in Yemen — framework, stated purpose, awareness activity, implementation, complaints and redress, enforcement and consumer outcomes — and the evidence held for each.

Who or what does it apply to?

Official instruments and guidance of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), with context attributed to the OECD

When was it measured or observed?

2021 to 2024; later stages have no evidence

How current is it?

The latest official source in this record dates from 23 March 2024, and the OECD analysis from 2026. No evidence on implementation, enforcement or consumer outcomes is held for any date.

What this evidence does not establish

The existence of an instrument does not by itself establish a complaint path, implementation or effective protection, and OECD analysis or other secondary material does not raise the evidence to that level.

How was it produced?

Each stage is assessed from official sources of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) — the 2023 Instructions announcement and the 2024 awareness material and brochure — with OECD analysis used as context only; a stage with no observed evidence is recorded as open.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?
